topic_ko: 서구 문화에서 빨강의 절대적 우위와 언어적 증거
_note: 삽입(논설/문화사) FULL set. 유형마다 passage를 다르게 paraphrase. grammar/vocab의 밑줄 어구는 해당 passage 문장에 글자 그대로 존재. insert의 insert_sentence·passage_marked text도 동일.

passage: Throughout Western history, red stood apart from all other colors as the only one truly deserving the name.
Both in historical records and in cultural hierarchies, it surpassed every other hue without exception.
Other colors existed, of course, but they were not recognized as colors for a very long time.
Humanity's earliest ventures into color ― its first experiments and first achievements ― all centered on red.
And it was within the spectrum of reds that people first learned to vary their palette and produce distinct tones.
Linguistic evidence aligns perfectly with this pictorial history.
In several languages, one word covers both 'red' and simply 'having color,' reflecting red's unique status.
In Russian, moreover, the words for 'red' and 'beautiful' trace back to a single common root.
choices: the symbolic role of red in religious ceremonies across cultures
how red dominated Western color culture historically and linguistically
the development of color pigments in ancient cave paintings
why modern artists prefer warm tones over cool tones
the evolution of color terminology in East Asian languages
theme.explanation_ko: 서구 역사에서 빨강이 유일한 진정한 색으로 군림했으며, 이것이 언어(어휘·어근)에도 반영되었다는 내용. 빨강이 역사적·언어적으로 서구 색채 문화를 지배했다는 ②가 주제이다.
theme.distractor_ko: ①종교 의식의 빨강, ③동굴 그림 안료, ④화가의 색 선호, ⑤동아시아 언어는 본문 초점과 다르다.

passage: For ages, red was the sole color considered worthy of the name in Western culture.
No other hue could match it in terms of historical prestige or cultural rank.
While other colors existed, they remained unrecognized as true colors for centuries.
All of humanity's pioneering work with color began with red and spread outward from there.
The color vocabulary of ancient languages faithfully mirrors this pictorial reality.
Some words mean both 'red' and simply 'colored' ― because for a long time, they were the same thing.
And in Russian, the root linking 'red' and 'beautiful' is a linguistic fossil of this ancient equation.
Red, in short, was not merely a color ― it was color itself.
choices: How Pigments Shaped Ancient Artistic Traditions
Red: The Original and Supreme Color of the West
Why Languages Struggle to Define Color Precisely
The Beautiful Science of Color Perception
From Red to Rainbow: The Expansion of Color Culture
title.explanation_ko: 서구에서 빨강이 수천 년간 '원조이자 최고의 색'이었다는 글의 핵심을 가장 압축적으로 담은 ②가 제목으로 적절하다.
title.distractor_ko: ①안료와 예술, ③언어의 색 정의 어려움, ④색 지각 과학, ⑤빨강에서 무지개로의 확장은 본문 핵심(빨강의 절대 우위)과 다르다.

passage: For thousands of years in the West, red was the only color worthy of that name, the only true color.
As much on the historical as hierarchical level, it exceeded all others.
Not that they did not exist, but they had to wait a long time before they were considered colors and then played a comparable role in material culture, social codes, and systems of thought.
It was with red what humans did their first color experiments, achieved their first successes, and then constructed a chromatic universe.
Here the lexicon seems in keeping with pictorial practices and coloring techniques.
In certain languages, the same word can mean "red" or simply "colored," depending on the context, such as coloratus in classical Latin or colorado in modern Castilian.

In other languages, the words meaning "red" and "beautiful" share a common root; for example, that is the case in Russian, in which the terms krasnyy (red) and krasivy (beautiful) belong to the same lexical family.
grammar.explanation_ko: ④ 'It was with red ~ that ...' 강조 분열문에서 접속사는 반드시 that이어야 한다. what은 선행사 없는 관계대명사/의문사이므로 이 구조에 쓸 수 없다 → that으로 고쳐야 한다.
grammar.distractor_ko: ①worthy of(~에 걸맞은) 형용사구, ②타동사 exceeded + 목적어, ③수동태 were considered, ⑤전치사+관계대명사 in which 모두 어법상 옳다.

passage: For thousands of years in the West, red was the only color worthy of that name, the only true color.
As much on the historical as hierarchical level, it exceeded all others.
Not that they did not exist, but they had to wait a long time before they were considered colors and then played a comparable role in material culture, social codes, and systems of thought.
It was with red that humans did their first color experiments, achieved their first successes, and then constructed a chromatic universe.
Here the lexicon seems at odds with pictorial practices and coloring techniques.
In certain languages, the same word can mean "red" or simply "colored," depending on the context, such as coloratus in classical Latin or colorado in modern Castilian.

In other languages, the words meaning "red" and "beautiful" share a common root; for example, that is the case in Russian, in which the terms krasnyy (red) and krasivy (beautiful) belong to the same lexical family.
vocab.explanation_ko: ⑤ 글의 논점은 어휘 체계(lexicon)가 회화 관행과 '일치(in keeping with)'한다는 것이다. 'at odds with'(~와 불일치하여)는 글의 주장과 정반대의 의미이므로 문맥상 틀리다 → in keeping with로 고쳐야 한다.
vocab.distractor_ko: ①worthy of(~에 걸맞은), ②exceeded(능가했다), ③comparable(비교할 만한), ④chromatic(색채의)는 모두 문맥에 적절하다.

passage: For thousands of years in the West, red was the only color truly deserving of that name.
Both historically and hierarchically, it surpassed every other hue.
Other colors existed but were not recognized as genuine colors for centuries.
It was through red that humanity conducted its earliest color experiments and built its entire chromatic world.
And within the range of reds, people first learned to diversify the palette and create varied tones.
This reality is reflected in language: in some languages, 'red' and 'colored' are expressed by the same word.
Russian offers the clearest example: krasnyy (red) and krasivy (beautiful) share a common root.

blank.explanation_ko: 앞에서 어휘(같은 단어가 '빨간'과 '색 있는'을 모두 의미)가 빨강의 우위를 반영한다고 했고, 뒤에서 러시아어 어근 사례가 이어진다. 따라서 빈칸에는 '언어 기록이 빨강의 색채 지배를 확인해 준다'는 내용이 들어가야 한다. ①이 정답.
blank.distractor_ko: ②현대 표준화, ③문화적 맥락과 아름다움, ④색채어 수와 언어 연령, ⑤안료 가격은 본문 논지(빨강=색의 대표)와 무관하다.

order.given: For thousands of years in the West, red was the only color worthy of that name, the only true color. As much on the historical as hierarchical level, it exceeded all others.

blocks.A: Here the lexicon seems in keeping with pictorial practices and coloring techniques. In certain languages, the same word covers both 'red' and simply 'colored,' as coloratus in classical Latin illustrates.
blocks.B: Not that other colors did not exist, but they had to wait before being recognized as true colors and playing a comparable role in culture and thought.
blocks.C: It was with red that humans conducted their first color experiments, achieved their first successes, and constructed a chromatic universe — diversifying the palette within the spectrum of reds.

order.explanation_ko: 주어진 글(빨강의 절대 우위)에 이어 (B)에서 다른 색들이 인정받지 못했음을 부연하고, (C)에서 빨강을 통한 최초 실험과 색채 세계 구축을 진술하며, (A)에서 어휘 체계가 이 사실을 확인해 준다고 마무리한다. (B)-(C)-(A).
order.distractor_ko: (A)의 lexicon 이야기는 (C)의 '색채 세계 구축' 뒤에 오는 증거이고, (B)는 주어진 글의 '다른 색들은 지위가 낮았다'는 부연이므로 먼저 온다.

insert.insert_sentence: It was also within the range of reds that they learned early on to diversify the palette and to produce varied tones and shades, as the oldest known color terms demonstrate.

Not that they did not exist, but they had to wait a long time before they were considered colors and then played a comparable role in material culture, social codes, and systems of thought.

Here the lexicon seems in keeping with pictorial practices and coloring techniques.
In certain languages, the same word can mean "red" or simply "colored," depending on the context, such as coloratus in classical Latin or colorado in modern Castilian.

insert.explanation_ko: 주어진 문장의 도입어 'also'는 앞 문장과의 추가 관계를 나타낸다. ③의 바로 앞 문장 'It was with red that humans did their first color experiments...'는 빨강을 통한 실험·성과·색채 세계 구축을 진술하고, 주어진 문장은 '또한 빨강의 범주에서 팔레트 다양화를 배웠다'고 덧붙인다. 그리고 직후 문장 'Here the lexicon seems in keeping with...'가 '가장 오래된 색채어'(color terms)를 lexicon으로 받아 연결된다.
insert.distractor_ko: ①②에는 아직 색 실험에 대한 진술이 없어 'also'가 연결할 대상이 없다. ④에 넣으면 lexicon 이야기(이미 처리됨) 뒤에 색채어 증거가 역순으로 오게 된다. ⑤는 구체 언어 사례가 시작된 이후여서 논리가 후퇴한다.

passage: In the West, red was for thousands of years the only color considered truly worthy of the name.
At every level ― historical and hierarchical ― it surpassed all others.
Other colors existed but were not granted the status of 'true colors' for a very long time.
All of humanity's early color experiments were conducted through red, which served as the foundation of the entire chromatic world.
People also first diversified their color range within the spectrum of reds.
This is corroborated by linguistic evidence: in some languages, the word for 'red' doubles as the word for 'colored.'
In Russian, the roots of 'red' and 'beautiful' are identical.
Red was not just one color among many ― it was the original color, the one that gave all others their meaning.
summary.summary_template: In Western culture, red held __(A)__ status as the only genuine color for centuries, and this dominance is confirmed by __(B)__ evidence showing that 'red' and 'colored' or 'beautiful' shared the same roots in several languages.
summary.explanation_ko: 서구에서 빨강은 (A)superior(우월한) 지위를 가졌으며, 이는 (B)linguistic(언어적) 증거(같은 단어가 '빨간'과 '색 있는'·'아름다운'을 뜻함)로 확인된다. ①이 정답.
summary.distractor_ko: (A)inferior/equal는 본문('only true color', 'exceeded all others')과 반대. (B)visual/scientific은 본문의 어휘·어근 증거와 맞지 않는다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 인류가 최초의 색 실험을 하고 색채 세계를 구축한 것은 바로 빨강을 통해서였다.
writing.answer: It was with red that humans did their first color experiments and constructed a chromatic universe.
writing.explanation_ko: 강조 분열문: It was + 강조어구(with red) + that + 나머지 주절.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 이 점에서 어휘 체계는 회화적 관행 및 채색 기법과 일치하는 것으로 보인다.
writing.answer: Here the lexicon seems in keeping with pictorial practices and coloring techniques.
writing.explanation_ko: seem + in keeping with ~(~와 일치하여) 구조. in keeping with는 하나의 형용사구로 분리 불가.

writing.question: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 다른 색들은 색으로 여겨지기까지 오랜 시간을 기다려야 했으며, 그런 다음에야 물질문화, 사회적 규범, 사상 체계에서 비교할 만한 역할을 하게 되었다.
conditions: Not that ~ but ... 구문으로 시작할 것
writing.answer: Not that they did not exist, but they had to wait a long time before they were considered colors and then played a comparable role in material culture, social codes, and systems of thought.
writing.explanation_ko: Not that A, but B 양보 구문 + 수동태 were considered + 비교 형용사 comparable.

writing.question: 다음 밑줄 친 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: In other languages, the words meaning "red" and "beautiful" share a common root; for example, that is the case in Russian, in which the terms krasnyy (red) and krasivy (beautiful) belong to the same lexical family.
writing.answer: 또 다른 언어들에서는 '빨간색'과 '아름다운'을 의미하는 단어들이 공통 어근을 공유하는데, 예를 들어 그것은 러시아어에서의 경우이며, 거기서 krasnyy(빨간색)와 krasivy(아름다운)라는 용어가 동일한 어휘 계열에 속한다.
writing.explanation_ko: the words meaning ~(~을 의미하는 단어들), share a common root(공통 어근을 공유하다), in which(그 언어에서), belong to the same lexical family(동일한 어휘 계열에 속하다).

writing.question: 다음 글을 읽고, 요약문의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 단어를 본문에 근거하여 쓰시오.
writing.summary: In the West, red (A)___________ all other colors for thousands of years, and this dominance is confirmed by the (B)___________, which shows that some languages use the same word for 'red' and 'colored.'
writing.explanation_ko: (A) 빨강은 다른 모든 색을 '능가했다(exceeded)'. (B) 이 사실은 '어휘 체계(lexicon)'에 의해 확인된다.

writing.question: 다음 글의 주제를 나타내는 한 문장을 아래 조건에 맞게 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 서구 문화에서 빨강은 역사적으로 유일한 진정한 색이었으며, 이는 여러 언어의 어휘 체계에도 반영되어 있다.
writing.answer: Red historically dominated Western color culture as the only true color, a fact reflected in language.
writing.explanation_ko: Red + historically(역사적으로) + dominated Western color culture + as the only true color + 어휘 체계 반영의 부대 상황절.
